tools.name: inventory-intelligence_stockout-risk-calculate

tools.name: inventory-intelligence_reorder-point-calculate
tools.description: Calculate reorderPoint = averageDailyDemand × (leadTimeDays + reviewDays) + safetyStock from supplied history and lead times. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/inventory-intelligence/reorder-point-calculate Keywords: when planning stock or a reorder, text, csv, file, products, sales, suppliers

tools.name: inventory-intelligence_safety-stock-calculate
tools.description: Calculate safetyStock = serviceLevelZ × demandStdev × sqrt(leadTimeDays). tools.name: inventory-intelligence_excess-detect

tools.name: inventory-intelligence_slow-moving-stock-detect
tools.description: Flag SKUs whose supplied unit sales over the disclosed lookback are at or below the slowUnits threshold. tools.name: inventory-intelligence_demand-forecast
